title: FinGuard: Multi-Tenant Loan & ML Risk System
tagline: Enterprise loan management with real-time XGBoost credit risk scoring and SHAP factor analysis.
description: Multi-tenant PERN / FastAPI loan system engineered with 4 distinct actor roles (Superadmin, Tenant Admin, Worker, Customer), integrating an XGBoost credit risk classification model evaluated with cost-weighted thresholding and real-time SHAP explainability.
overview: FinGuard is an enterprise loan platform architected with strict multi-tenant isolation and 4 distinct actor roles (Superadmin, Tenant Admin, Worker, and Customer). The system offloads credit-risk evaluation to a high-throughput Python/FastAPI microservice running an XGBoost gradient-boosted decision tree pipeline.
pipeline: Role-based multi-tenant PERN core with granular permissions for Superadmins, Tenant Admins, Workers, and Customers
High-throughput FastAPI microservice serving real-time credit-risk inferences
XGBoost classification model evaluated with cost-weighted approval threshold (0.3748)
Real-time SHAP factor analysis providing transparent risk explanations for loan officers

title: AI Lyric & Next-Word Generator (PyTorch LSTM)
tagline: PyTorch LSTM language model trained on song lyrics for sequence prediction and lyric generation.
description: PyTorch-based LSTM neural network language model trained on lyric_dataset.txt corpus with NLTK tokenization, learned word embeddings, and a FastAPI inference server for real-time text completion.
overview: A deep learning sequence generation engine built with PyTorch. The model tokenizes text using NLTK, trains an LSTM network with embedding layers over lyric_dataset.txt, and serves inference through an asynchronous FastAPI endpoint with temperature-controlled sampling.
pipeline: Text preprocessing and NLTK vocabulary tokenization over lyric_dataset.txt
Sequence modeling with multi-layer LSTM and learned dense word embedding representations
Temperature-controlled multinomial next-word probability distribution sampling
FastAPI inference server containerized for low-latency prompt completion

title: DataSphere: Structured Data Intelligence
tagline: Automated tabular ingestion, natural language SQL querying, and interactive data visualizer.
description: Ingests CSV, XLS, and XLSX tabular data into PostgreSQL, with Python FastAPI backend, React frontend, Gemini API natural language query translation, and interactive charting (early prototype).
overview: DataSphere automates the ingestion of arbitrary tabular spreadsheets (CSV, XLS, XLSX) into dynamically generated PostgreSQL tables. An LLM-assisted query engine powered by the Gemini API translates plain English prompts into safe SQL queries, visualized instantaneously via reactive charts.
pipeline: Multi-format ingestion pipeline supporting CSV, XLS, and XLSX spreadsheets
Automated schema inference and dynamic PostgreSQL table generation
Gemini API natural language prompt-to-SQL translation layer
FastAPI backend and React frontend with interactive charting components
metrics: Gemini API natural language query translation

title: ExpendWise: Financial Risk & Expense Analytics
tagline: Financial risk classifier and moving-average expense trend forecasting platform.
description: Financial risk classifier trained on 5,000 synthetic records with 9 features. Risk tiers mapped via savings ratio. 200-tree RandomForestClassifier (max depth 10) with moving-average expense trend forecasting (clarified no RandomForestRegressor is used and synthetic training limitations noted).
overview: Personal finance risk analytics engine. Uses a 200-tree RandomForestClassifier (max depth 10) trained on 5,000 synthetic financial records across 9 distinct economic features. Risk tiers are mapped using savings ratios, and expenditure trends are forecasted using moving-average algorithms.
pipeline: Feature engineering across 9 financial attributes over 5,000 synthetic records
Risk tier segmentation mapped via empirical savings ratios
200-tree RandomForestClassifier (max depth 10) classification model
Moving-average trend forecasting without regressor overfitting

title: SnapAttendance: Biometric Face & Geofenced Attendance
tagline: Multi-pose facial verification pipeline with HOG-SVM classification and GPS geofencing.
description: Biometric attendance system with MTCNN 5-landmark face detector, head-pose gating, 15,876-dim HOG extraction, RBF SVM with 5-fold CV, multi-pose confirmation, and Haversine GPS geofencing within 200m.
overview: A high-precision biometric attendance platform. The pipeline detects faces via MTCNN with 5 landmarks, enforces geometric head-pose gating, standardizes images with histogram equalization, extracts 15,876-dimensional HOG features, classifies identity with an RBF-kernel SVM (grid searched C and gamma), confirms across 3 poses (> 0.75 confidence), and verifies location via Haversine GPS geofencing (0.2 km).
pipeline: MTCNN face detection with 5 facial landmarks (eyes, nose, mouth corners) and head-pose gating
Grayscale preprocessing, equalizeHist histogram equalization, 128x128 resize, and 4x data augmentation
15,876-dimensional Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) feature extraction
RBF-kernel SVM tuned with 5-fold cross-validation grid search across C and gamma
Multi-frame confirmation requiring confidence > 0.75 across 3 distinct poses (front, right, left)
Haversine formula GPS geofencing endpoint verifying attendance within 0.2 km (200m)
metrics: Haversine GPS geofence threshold within 200m (0.2 km)
5-Fold CV Grid Search optimized RBF SVM

title: Lexical Duplicate Question Detector
tagline: NLP duplicate question classifier with token features and fuzzy substring ratios.
description: Streamlit NLP classifier using Random Forest and XGBoost with token features, substring ratios, and fuzzy string matching to detect semantically duplicate queries with 72% accuracy.
overview: An applied NLP system that identifies duplicate question pairs using advanced feature engineering: token count differences, token intersections, fuzzy matching ratios, and length heuristics passed to Random Forest and XGBoost classifiers.
pipeline: Text tokenization, lowercasing, and punctuation filtering
Fuzzy string ratio and token set matching extraction
Classification using Random Forest and XGBoost models
Interactive Streamlit application for real-time duplicate scoring

title: DigitalMandu: Multi-Tenant Marketplace
tagline: Multi-tenant e-commerce marketplace with store isolation, Khalti payments, and modular React.
description: Multi-tenant e-commerce marketplace with tenant store isolation, product catalog, Khalti payment gateway integration, reviews, ratings, and modular React components.
overview: A multi-tenant e-commerce platform offering independent store isolation for vendors, comprehensive product and catalog management, customer reviews and rating systems, and end-to-end checkout integration with the Khalti payment gateway.
pipeline: Multi-tenant vendor store isolation with secure database scoping
Product catalog management, inventory tracking, and search indexing
Khalti payment gateway webhook integration and transaction verification
Modular React frontend with accessible checkout workflows

title: Chatopia: Real-Time Collaborative Messaging
tagline: Real-time WebSocket chat application supporting 100+ concurrent sessions.
description: MERN and WebSocket chat application supporting 100+ concurrent users with JWT authentication, instant message broadcasting, active status indicators, and Zustand client state management.
overview: High-concurrency instant messaging service built on Socket.io and Node.js. Features room-based chat channels, real-time presence awareness, JWT session authentication, and persistent chat message archives in MongoDB.
pipeline: WebSocket event pipeline for sub-millisecond bidirectional communication
JWT-based handshake authentication and authorization
Active user presence tracking and broadcast listeners
Zustand reactive client state synchronization

title: Falodhyam Agricultural E-Commerce
tagline: Agricultural trade portal with catalog, wishlist, and inventory tracking.
description: Full-featured agricultural commerce platform with role-based access, automated stock inventory management, cart workflows, and responsive customer interface.
overview: Web platform designed to connect agricultural producers with consumers. Provides dedicated inventory controls for agricultural suppliers, structured produce categories, customer cart and wishlist handling, and order fulfillment tracking.
pipeline: Relational database design for perishable agricultural commodities
Role-based authentication for farmers, distributors, and buyers
Automated inventory decrementing and re-stock threshold alerts
Responsive customer ordering and catalog interface
